requirements.rule: Art. 34 cc. 3, 4, 7: the engine pays the level-specific allowances only while the caller states the qualifying roles. It cannot independently verify a child's age, the number of persons assisted, or certification validity, written notice and delivery of its copy. Nor does it automatically offset the allowances of cc. 3 and 4 against an individual superminimo or that of c. 7 against better treatment received overall; the caller must state individual pay net of any offset.
requirements.remediation: Verify role eligibility externally and state individual pay net of any offset; to automate this, model child age, assisted persons, certification validity and notice, and the applicable offsets.
